payload.title: Let agents publish tasks.md releases without asking, once safe
payload.body: Owner request 2026-10-16: auto-publish to npm without asking, only when safe. Deliver scripts/setup-npm-trusted-publishing.sh (one-time owner trust setup, idempotent) and a documented autonomous-release rule (version PR merged, gate green on main, tag matches package.json, version not on npm; then gh release create; publish.yml publishes via OIDC).
